facts.fact: The Herald reports the eGP system, launched by President Mnangagwa in October 2023, became operational on 1 January 2024 and lets all public entities and bidders run procurement electronically.
PRAZ upgraded the e-GP system to Phase 1.3 in early 2025, covering e-evaluation, e-award, e-contract management, framework agreements and management information reports, for all public entities.
